title: The Lavender Bundle above the Stove
youtube_title: The Lavender Bundle above the Stove | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Kavi wants to check on a lavender bundle hung where the air was warm, not hot before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Kavi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
